summary: {person} shows the planner how a single early departure changes who can clock in on time.
realLife: Milwaukee added an early trip to each of Routes 33 and 34 in its spring changes to help employees reach six o’clock shifts.
gates: A new early departure serves a documented work shift.
weights: A shift beginning before the second trip makes the first departure decisive.
inGame: needs: work shift, new first trip and scheduled arrival at the workplace stop.

turns.what: The office verifies the arrival with the timetable.
turns.pulledBy: The worker can walk from the stop before the shift begins.

turns.what: The worker supplies the missed transfer time.
turns.pulledBy: The bus arrives in time but the connecting service does not.
turns.writesBack: Open a connection review for the feeder trip.
